cells.gaps: No source found shows three or more health systems exchanging data: the vaccination register and medicines system are named as integrated in DHIS2 or interoperable with it, not which. No national health identifier linking records is reported.
cells.note: Stage 3: in October 2026 the health ministry said DHIS2 works with the electronic vaccination register and the medicines management system in routine use (COM-001). Whether these are modules of DHIS2 or separate systems exchanging with it is not stated, so three-way exchange, and stage 4, is not shown.
